mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% within a 3-month window, it signals economic weakness triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential housing starts and consumer credit availability signal weakening demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing supply contraction regime (INDPRO below 100), production bottlenecks reduce corporate margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential housing starts signals expanding consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index rises above 245.0 in a 1-month window, it signals inflationary pressure triggering monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 245.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and rising unemployment rate signal labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS growth is negative and UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a consumer demand expansion regime (HOUST and RSAFS both rising), the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns due to increased corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS exceed the threshold.
